label: TP
reason: User input from request parameters flows directly into an HTML template via format() method without any sanitization or encoding. The parameter 'param' is assigned to 'bar', passed through doSomething(), returned unchanged, placed in an array, and written to the HTTP response body within an HTML document structure. This allows reflected XSS attacks where malicious scripts can be executed in victim browsers.

evidence.note: User input extracted from request parameters and used unsanitized in HTML output
